Background (from the session that started this one):
JusPrin 2 (an OrcaSlicer fork at /Users/kenneth/Projects/JusPrin, development branch `jusprin-dev`, stable/release branch `main`) is about to roll out: first to the team, then hand-picked testers, then publicly. The server side is live in production. The next step needs an installable signed build of `jusprin-dev`, and the nightly that produces it has been failing for two days. A Linux failure was a runner DNS problem; the macOS jobs never got a runner. Nobody has investigated yet.

Task:
The JusPrin nightly build of `jusprin-dev` has failed on 2026-11-10 (run 42847372736) and 2026-11-11 (run 43049244324), so there is no signed build of the current `jusprin-dev` for the team to install as the first step of the JusPrin 2 rollout.

What I saw (not yet explained):
- Both days the two macOS jobs "Build / Build macOS arm64 / Find the deps cache" and the x86_64 one never got a runner: `runner_name` empty, no steps, labels `macos-15`, then cancelled about 95 minutes later.
- On 2026-11-11, "Build / Build Linux x64 / Build JusPrin" failed after apt on the runner could not resolve `azure.archive.ubuntu.com` for over an hour.
- The `jusprin-dev` run is dispatched at the same minute as the scheduled nightly on `main` (workflow `.github/workflows/jusprin_nightly.yml`, job "Start the build on jusprin-dev"), and `main`'s run succeeded both days. A guess, not checked: the two runs compete for macOS runners and the `jusprin-dev` one waits until something cancels it.

Do: find the real reason the macOS jobs never start and why the run is cancelled (job timeouts, concurrency groups, GitHub's macOS concurrency limit, billing), fix it in the workflow if it is ours, and get one green signed nightly of `jusprin-dev` (macOS signed with `-f sign_macos=true`, Windows, Linux). Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and AGENTS.md's Branches section first; `main` changes only with Kenneth's yes, and GitHub runs scheduled workflows from `main`'s copy of the file. Report what the cause was, what you changed, and the run link.

name: JusPrin nightly

# Builds jusprin-dev, the development branch, once a day and puts the files
# on the "nightly-builds" pre-release, replacing the day before's, as
# JusPrin 1's "Build all" did.
#
# - GitHub runs scheduled workflows only on the default branch, main. The
#   scheduled run therefore only starts this workflow again on jusprin-dev,
#   so every step, OrcaSlicer's dependency build included, checks out
#   jusprin-dev.
# - The build is the release's (jusprin_build_all.yml), so a nightly is what a
#   release from the same commit would be. Its version is the one in
#   src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Updates/Version.hpp.
# - The files keep JusPrin 1's nightly names, so download links stay the
#   same: JusPrin_Windows_Installer_nightly.exe,
#   JusPrin_Windows_nightly_portable.zip, JusPrin_Mac_universal_nightly.dmg,
#   JusPrin_Linux_AppImage_Ubuntu2404_nightly.AppImage, and SHA256SUMS.txt.
# - The nightly-builds tag moves to the commit built, and the release notes
#   name it. The scheduled build is skipped when jusprin-dev has not changed
#   since the last nightly.
# - The macOS app is signed and notarised; Windows builds are unsigned.
# - The app's update check never offers a nightly: it reads only tags named
#   vX.Y.Z and jusprin/vX.Y.Z (ReleaseFeed.cpp).
#
# Run it by hand from Actions > JusPrin nightly > Run workflow, with the
# branch set to jusprin-dev.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '35 7 * * *' # near midnight US Pacific time, as JusPrin 1's nightly
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      sign_macos:
        description: 'Sign and notarise the macOS app with the Apple secrets'
        type: boolean
        default: true
      only_if_changed:
        description: 'Skip the build when jusprin-dev has not changed since the last nightly'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write   # move the tag and replace the pre-release's files
  actions: write    # the scheduled run starts the build on jusprin-dev

concurrency:
  group: jusprin-nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  TAG: nightly-builds

jobs:
  start:
    name: Start the build on jusprin-dev
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run jusprin_nightly.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref jusprin-dev \
            -f sign_macos=true -f only_if_changed=true

  prepare:
    name: Check what to build
    # Only the development branch is published as the nightly.
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/jusprin-dev'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      build: ${{ steps.changed.outputs.build }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout: src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Read the version
        id: version
        run: |
          echo "version=$(node src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Packaging/release.mjs version src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Updates/Version.hpp)" \
            | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Skip an unchanged jusprin-dev
        id: changed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          built=$(gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body | sed -n 's/^Commit: \([0-9a-f]*\).*/\1/p')
          if [ "${{ inputs.only_if_changed }}" = "true" ] && [ "$built" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
            echo "The nightly is already built from $GITHUB_SHA."
            echo "build=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "build=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.build == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/jusprin_build_all.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
      sign_macos: ${{ inputs.sign_macos }}
    secrets: inherit

  publish:
    name: Update the nightly-builds pre-release
    needs: [prepare, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
      SIGNED_MACOS: ${{ inputs.sign_macos }}
    steps:
      - name: Collect the files
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: jusprin-*
          path: collected
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Give them the nightly names
        run: |
          mkdir dist
          for file in collected/*; do
            name=$(basename "$file")
            # The per-architecture Mac bundles only feed the universal app.
            case "$name" in JusPrin_Mac_bundle_*) continue ;; esac
            name=${name/_V$VERSION/_nightly}
            name=${name/_x64/}
            cp "$file" "dist/$name"
          done
          (cd dist && sha256sum -- * > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          cat dist/SHA256SUMS.txt

      - name: Replace the files and move the tag
        run: |
          gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/tags/$TAG" -f sha="$GITHUB_SHA" -F force=true > /dev/null

      # Last, so the notes name a commit only once its files are up.
      - name: Write the notes
        run: |
          mac=$([ "$SIGNED_MACOS" = "true" ] && echo "signed and notarised" || echo "unsigned")
          cat > notes.md <<EOF
          The latest JusPrin $VERSION test build from jusprin-dev, the development branch, rebuilt every night. It may be broken; for a tested version, use the [latest release](https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest).

          - Windows: the installer or the portable zip. Unsigned, so Windows may warn before opening it.
          - macOS (Apple silicon and Intel): the disk image, $mac.
          - Linux (x64): the AppImage.

          Built $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC') by [this run](https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID).

          Commit: $GITHUB_SHA
          EOF
          gh release edit "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --title "JusPrin Nightly Builds" --notes-file notes.md

name: JusPrin build all

# Every platform of JusPrin from one commit, for jusprin_release.yml (a draft
# release) and jusprin_nightly.yml (the nightly-builds pre-release).
#
# Each platform is built by jusprin_release_build.yml; the macos job joins the
# two macOS architectures into the universal app and its disk image. The
# files are left as this run's artifacts named jusprin-*, for the caller to
# collect: the Windows x64 installer and portable zip, the macOS universal
# disk image, the Linux x64 AppImage, and the per-architecture Mac bundles,
# which only feed the universal app.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        required: true
        type: string
      # Sign and notarise the macOS app with the Apple secrets JusPrin 1.x
      # used. Windows builds are unsigned.
      sign_macos:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Windows x64
            os: windows-latest
            arch: x64
          - name: macOS arm64
            os: macos-15
            arch: arm64
          - name: macOS x86_64
            os: macos-15
            arch: x86_64
          - name: Linux x64
            os: ubuntu-24.04
            arch: ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/jusprin_release_build.yml
    with:
      os: ${{ matrix.os }}
      arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
      version: ${{ inputs.version }}
    secrets: inherit

  macos:
    name: macOS universal
    needs: build
    runs-on: macos-15
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      SIGN: ${{ inputs.sign_macos && '1' || '0' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          lfs: 'false'

      - uses: lukka/get-cmake@latest
        with:
          cmakeVersion: "~4.3.0"
          useLocalCache: true
          useCloudCache: true

      - name: Get both architectures
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: jusprin-macOS-*
          path: mac_bundles
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Join them into the universal app
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/arm64 build/x86_64
          tar -xzf mac_bundles/JusPrin_Mac_bundle_arm64.tar.gz -C build/arm64
          tar -xzf mac_bundles/JusPrin_Mac_bundle_x86_64.tar.gz -C build/x86_64
          ./build_release_macos.sh -u -x -j 1 -a universal -t 10.15

      # As OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml loads the certificate, with the secret
      # names JusPrin 1.x used.
      - name: Load the signing certificate
        if: env.SIGN == '1'
        env:
          BUILD_CERTIFICATE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.BUILD_CERTIFICATE_BASE64 }}
          P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.P12_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          certificate="$RUNNER_TEMP/build_certificate.p12"
          keychain="$RUNNER_TEMP/app-signing.keychain-db"
          echo -n "$BUILD_CERTIFICATE_BASE64" | base64 --decode --output "$certificate"
          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$keychain"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$keychain"
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$keychain"
          security default-keychain -s "$keychain"
          security import "$certificate" -P "$P12_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$keychain"
          security list-keychain -d user -s "$keychain"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$P12_PASSWORD" "$keychain"

      - name: Make the disk image
        env:
          JUSPRIN_SIGN: ${{ env.SIGN }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          APPLE_DEV_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEV_ACCOUNT }}
          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.TEAM_ID }}
          APP_PWD: ${{ secrets.APP_PWD }}
        run: |
          ./src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Packaging/macos_package.sh \
            build/universal/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer.app "$VERSION" dist

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: jusprin-macOS-universal
          path: dist/*.dmg
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

name: Check Cache

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        required: true
        type: string
      arch:
        required: false
        type: string
      compiler:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: msvc
      build-deps-only:
        required: false
        type: boolean
      force-build:
        required: false
        type: boolean
  
# Read by scripts/ci_deps_cache.sh.
env:
  REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
  WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
  BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}

jobs:
  check_cache: # determines if there is a cache and outputs variables used in caching process
    name: Check Cache
    # Hosted macOS runners are scarce, so their lookup runs on Linux.
    runs-on: ${{ startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') && 'ubuntu-24.04' || inputs.os }}
    outputs:
      cache-key: ${{ steps.set_outputs.outputs.cache-key }}
      cache-path: ${{ steps.set_outputs.outputs.cache-path }}
      valid-cache: ${{ steps.cache_deps.outputs.cache-hit }}
      macos-path: ${{ steps.macos_path.outputs.path }}
      key-inputs: ${{ steps.wait_check.outputs.key-inputs }}
      wait-for: ${{ steps.wait_check.outputs.wait-for }}
      wait-since: ${{ steps.wait_check.outputs.wait-since }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: 'false'
          # The wait check compares the merge commit with its first parent.
          fetch-depth: ${{ startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') && 2 || 1 }}
          # Fetches only deps/, which the key hashes, and the wait script.
          sparse-checkout: |
            /deps/
            /scripts/ci_deps_cache.sh
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
        
      - name: set outputs
        id: set_outputs
        env:
          # Anything that changes how the tree is built belongs in the key, or a job
          # restores one it cannot use. Linux amd64 passes no arch deliberately, so
          # 'linux-clang' keeps the cache it already has.
          cache-os: ${{ (runner.os == 'macOS' || startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-')) && format('{0}-{1}', inputs.os, inputs.arch) || (runner.os == 'Windows' && format('windows-{0}-{1}', inputs.arch, inputs.compiler) || format('linux-clang{0}', inputs.arch && format('-{0}', inputs.arch) || '')) }}
          # The Windows ARM64 deps build in build-arm64, all others under build;
          # build_deps.yml and build_orca.yml pass the Windows directory to build_win.bat.
          dep-folder-name: ${{ (runner.os == 'macOS' || startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-')) && format('/{0}', inputs.arch) || (runner.os == 'Windows' && inputs.arch == 'arm64') && '-arm64/OrcaSlicer_dep' || '/OrcaSlicer_dep' }}
          output-cmd: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '$env:GITHUB_OUTPUT' || '"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"'}}
        run: |
          echo cache-key=${{ env.cache-os }}-cache-orcaslicer_deps-build-${{ hashFiles('deps/**') }} >> ${{ env.output-cmd }}
          # Relative to the workspace, which differs from the build's when this job runs on Linux.
          echo cache-path=deps/build${{ env.dep-folder-name }} >> ${{ env.output-cmd }}
            
      # actions/cache matches the path too, so a Linux lookup for macOS uses the
      # workspace of a hosted macOS job.
      - name: macOS cache path
        id: macos_path
        if: ${{ startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') }}
        run: echo "path=/Users/runner/work/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}/${{ steps.set_outputs.outputs.cache-path }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: load cache
        id: cache_deps
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.macos_path.outputs.path || format('{0}/{1}', github.workspace, steps.set_outputs.outputs.cache-path) }}
          key: ${{ steps.set_outputs.outputs.cache-key }}
          lookup-only: true
        
      # A pull request that misses the cache can wait for a base branch build of the same deps.
      - name: check for a base branch build to wait for
        id: wait_check
        if: ${{ startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.cache_deps.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: bash scripts/ci_deps_cache.sh check

  wait_for_deps:
    name: Wait for base branch deps
    needs: [check_cache]
    if: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.wait-for != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      WAIT_MINUTES: 120
    # Must exceed WAIT_MINUTES.
    timeout-minutes: 130
    # Waiting runs queue here, and only the first one holds a runner.
    concurrency:
      group: deps-wait-${{ github.base_ref }}-${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.cache-key }}
      queue: max
    outputs:
      hit: ${{ steps.lookup.outputs.cache-hit }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          sparse-checkout: scripts/ci_deps_cache.sh
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: wait for the deps cache
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          KEY: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.cache-key }}
          KEY_INPUTS: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.key-inputs }}
          WAIT_FOR: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.wait-for }}
          WAIT_SINCE: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.wait-since }}
          ARCH: ${{ inputs.arch }}
        run: bash scripts/ci_deps_cache.sh wait

      - name: load cache
        id: lookup
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.macos-path }}
          key: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.cache-key }}
          lookup-only: true

  # Hosted macOS runners are scarce, so a pull request's macOS build waits until
  # one is free that push and nightly builds do not need. See the script.
  macos_admission:
    name: Wait for a macOS runner
    needs: [check_cache, wait_for_deps]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check_cache.result == 'success' && startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'macos-priority') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      WAIT_MINUTES: 240
      PRIORITY: false
    # Must exceed WAIT_MINUTES.
    timeout-minutes: 250
    # One line for every arch of every pull request, and only its first job polls.
    concurrency:
      group: macos-admission
      queue: max
    steps: &macos_admission_steps
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          sparse-checkout: scripts/ci_macos_admission.py
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: wait for a macOS runner
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MACOS_RUNNER_LIMIT: ${{ vars.MACOS_RUNNER_LIMIT }}
        # -u, or the log shows nothing until the wait ends.
        run: python3 -u scripts/ci_macos_admission.py

  # The macos-priority label, when the run starts, puts a pull request in its own
  # line, which the normal one yields to. The names are fixed, because a skipped
  # job is listed under its unevaluated name, and the script matches both.
  macos_admission_priority:
    name: Wait for a macOS runner (priority)
    needs: [check_cache, wait_for_deps]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check_cache.result == 'success' && startsWith(inputs.os, 'macos-') && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'macos-priority') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      WAIT_MINUTES: 240
      PRIORITY: true
    # Must exceed WAIT_MINUTES.
    timeout-minutes: 250
    concurrency:
      group: macos-admission-priority
      queue: max
    steps: *macos_admission_steps

  build_deps: # call next step
    name: Build Deps
    needs: [check_cache, wait_for_deps, macos_admission, macos_admission_priority]
    # A failed wait counts as no cache, so the deps are built here. A failed
    # admission still builds rather than skip macOS.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check_cache.result == 'success' }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build_deps.yml
    with:
      cache-key: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.cache-key }}
      cache-path: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.cache-path }}
      valid-cache: ${{ needs.check_cache.outputs.valid-cache == 'true' || needs.wait_for_deps.outputs.hit == 'true' }}
      os: ${{ inputs.os }}
      arch: ${{ inputs.arch }}
      compiler: ${{ inputs.compiler }}
      build-deps-only: ${{ inputs.build-deps-only }}
      force-build: ${{ inputs.force-build }}
    secrets: inherit

name: JusPrin release build

# One platform of a JusPrin release, called by jusprin_release.yml.
#
# The build is OrcaSlicer's: its dependency workflow (build_deps.yml), cached
# under the key OrcaSlicer's build_check_cache.yml uses, and its build
# scripts. Only the packaging is JusPrin's (src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Packaging).
# OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml can't be reused as it is: its Linux step looks
# for OrcaSlicer_Linux_V<version>.AppImage, which a JusPrin build never
# writes, and its packaging steps name everything OrcaSlicer.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        required: true
        type: string
      # x64 (Windows), arm64 or x86_64 (macOS); empty for Linux amd64, as in
      # OrcaSlicer's build_all.yml.
      arch:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      version:
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  cache:
    name: Find the deps cache
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    outputs:
      key: ${{ steps.key.outputs.key }}
      path: ${{ steps.key.outputs.path }}
      hit: ${{ steps.lookup.outputs.cache-hit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          lfs: 'false'
      - name: Compute the key
        id: key
        shell: bash
        env:
          # As in OrcaSlicer's build_check_cache.yml. The macOS and Linux trees are
          # OrcaSlicer's and share its cache; OrcaSlicer builds Windows with clang-cl,
          # so JusPrin's cl tree is cached on its own.
          cache_os: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' && format('{0}-{1}', inputs.os, inputs.arch) || (runner.os == 'Windows' && format('windows-{0}-msvc', inputs.arch) || format('linux-clang{0}', inputs.arch && format('-{0}', inputs.arch) || '')) }}
          dep_folder: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' && format('/{0}', inputs.arch) || (runner.os == 'Windows' && inputs.arch == 'arm64') && '-arm64/OrcaSlicer_dep' || '/OrcaSlicer_dep' }}
        run: |
          echo "key=${cache_os}-cache-orcaslicer_deps-build-${{ hashFiles('deps/**') }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          # Relative to the workspace, as build_deps.yml takes it.
          echo "path=deps/build${dep_folder}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Look the cache up
        id: lookup
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ steps.key.outputs.path }}
          key: ${{ steps.key.outputs.key }}
          lookup-only: true

  deps:
    name: Build deps
    needs: cache
    if: ${{ needs.cache.outputs.hit != 'true' }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build_deps.yml
    with:
      cache-key: ${{ needs.cache.outputs.key }}
      cache-path: ${{ needs.cache.outputs.path }}
      valid-cache: false
      os: ${{ inputs.os }}
      arch: ${{ inputs.arch }}
      # cl under the Visual Studio generator, which JusPrin's Windows build uses.
      compiler: msvc
      # Stops build_deps.yml before it calls OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml.
      build-deps-only: true
    secrets: inherit

  build:
    name: Build JusPrin
    needs: [cache, deps]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.cache.result == 'success' && (needs.deps.result == 'success' || needs.deps.result == 'skipped') }}
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          lfs: 'false'

      - name: Load the deps
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ needs.cache.outputs.path }}
          key: ${{ needs.cache.outputs.key }}
          fail-on-cache-miss: true

      # The same CMake as OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml.
      - uses: lukka/get-cmake@latest
        with:
          cmakeVersion: "~4.3.0"
          useLocalCache: true
          useCloudCache: true

      # The Agent and Home pages are built with npm (JusPrin/Web/CMakeLists.txt).
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      # Windows
      - name: Set up MSVC
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3

      - name: Install NSIS
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: choco install nsis

      - name: Build
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        # As OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml calls build_win.bat, but with cl rather than
        # clang-cl. -i installs into build\OrcaSlicer, which the packaging reads.
        run: |
          $deps = (Split-Path "${{ github.workspace }}/${{ needs.cache.outputs.path }}").Replace('\', '/')
          .\build_win.bat -s -i --arch ${{ inputs.arch }} --build-dir build --deps-dir $deps --msvc --msbuild

      - name: Package
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Packaging/windows_package.ps1 -BuildDir build -Version $env:VERSION `
            -Arch "${{ inputs.arch }}" -OutDir dist

      # macOS: each architecture is built here; jusprin_release.yml joins them
      # into the universal app and the disk image.
      - name: Prepare the Mac
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install libtool
          mkdir -p "${{ github.workspace }}/deps/build/${{ inputs.arch }}"
          # As OrcaSlicer's build_orca.yml does, for disk space: keep only the
          # selected Xcode.
          xcode=$(basename "$(cd "$(xcode-select -p)/../.." && pwd -P)")
          sudo find /Applications -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "Xcode_*.app" ! -name "$xcode" -exec rm -rf {} +
          sudo rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Caches/*

      - name: Build
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: ./build_release_macos.sh -s -n -x -j 3 -a ${{ inputs.arch }} -t 10.15

      - name: Package
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          tar -czf "dist/JusPrin_Mac_bundle_${{ inputs.arch }}.tar.gz" -C "build/${{ inputs.arch }}" OrcaSlicer

      # Linux
      - name: Install the build packages
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: ./.github/actions/apt-install-deps

      - name: Build
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          # -s builds the slicer and lays out build/package; JusPrin's AppImage
          # replaces OrcaSlicer's (-i).
          ./build_linux.sh -srlL
          ./scripts/check_appimage_libs.sh ./build/package ./build/package/bin/orca-slicer

      - name: Package
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          ./src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Packaging/appimage.sh build/package "$VERSION" \
            "dist/JusPrin_Linux_AppImage_Ubuntu2404_V${VERSION}${{ inputs.arch && format('_{0}', inputs.arch) || '' }}.AppImage"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: jusprin-${{ runner.os }}-${{ inputs.arch || 'x64' }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          # The release keeps the files; these only carry them to it.
          retention-days: 7

# Why the jusprin-dev nightly fails on macOS (2026-11-11)

Cause: GitHub-side. Every cancelled macOS job carries the annotation
"The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts"
plus "Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience
longer queue times". GitHub cancels a job that gets no hosted runner within 15 minutes
(created 15:31:57, cancelled 15:46:58; same 15 min on 11-09 and 11-10). The "95 minutes"
was the whole run waiting for the Windows build; the macOS jobs died at 15 minutes.

Not the cause:
- main's scheduled run: it only runs one 8-second Linux job; it shares the concurrency
  group "jusprin-nightly" but finishes before the jusprin-dev run starts.
- Billing: org is on the free plan, repo public, all macOS minutes free (usage API, net $0).
- Our concurrency limit: free plan allows 5 macOS jobs; the run asks for 2 at a time.

Time of day: 7 runs started 22:00-08:30 UTC (11-08/11-09) got macOS runners in seconds;
3 runs started 15:30-17:45 UTC got none. Community threads report the same since
~2026-11-02 (github.com/orgs/community/discussions/211885, /212069), no GitHub answer.
This repo's cron schedules fire 7-10 h late (nightly cron 07:35 UTC fires 15:31-17:44),
landing the nightly in the worst window. Upstream OrcaSlicer's crons fire within minutes.

jusprin_release_build.yml runs the macOS deps-cache lookup on ubuntu-24.04, as upstream's
build_check_cache.yml does. Five macOS runner acquisitions per nightly become three.
